A historical theorem on idempotent lifting may imply the weighted-cut count in another terminology; the present proof explicitly derives the precise formula and inverse reconstruction, but novelty beyond indexed sources is not human-certified.

value.rationale: Natural fixed-element decomposition multiplicities recover each symmetrized radical Peirce dimension and form a weighted cut partition function, giving a structural inverse theorem for all field-product semisimple-quotient finite-dimensional algebras.
